purpose: FreeRTOS-native touch console with the accepted Program Manager-style folder launcher, shared platform services, laptop-accessible persistent game data, versioned native game APIs, original Maze Chase and Space Invaders samples, built-in diagnostics, and an exclusive handoff to the proven Doom SFX plus MUS integration.

shell.input: bounded GT911 polling with up to five contacts

native_game_api.code_model: RISC-V machine code statically linked into the Console OS ELF
native_game_api.uf2_note: UF2 is a flashing container, not the executable format used by this ESP-IDF project.
native_game_api.audio: optional bounded tone service at PCM16 stereo 16000 Hz

game_storage.concurrency: automatic exclusive app-or-host ownership plus terminal game lease

next_hardware_step: After build verification, install the exact app-only successor while preserving the already-provisioned game_data volume; then verify the accepted Program Manager UI, J16 enumeration, seeded Doom identity, copy/delete/eject/reconnect behavior, reboot persistence, contention rejection, and Doom launch on the exact board.
